column1: #   on-pickup   - New idea added to pickup queue
#   on-digest   - Idea digested into issue or draft plan
#   on-freeze   - Plan locked into 🔷 Frozen backlog
#   on-start    - Plan activated into ⚡ In Development
#   on-done     - Plan completed and archived to done/
#   pre-sync    - Before worktree sync transport runs
#   on-sync     - Delegated worktree sync transport (aapp.syncStrategy = hook)
#   post-sync   - After worktree sync transport completes
#   gate   - Aborts lifecycle transition on failure/timeout (exit code 1)
#   notify - Emits advisory warning and proceeds on failure/timeout
